epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce entity cataloging workaround rate from >10% to 0%
requirements: R1: Validate and store protocol-specific attributes (procedural steps, author approvals) within the existing materials model.
R2: Validate and store data-specific structures (sample metrics, collection parameters) within the existing materials model.

slices.title: Patch existing materials API and model for protocols and data
slices.jtbd: When implementing entity specializations for this epic, I want to patch the existing material data model and API to accept protocol and data attributes, so that the knowledge base natively supports these subtypes.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material creation endpoint, When a user submits a protocol with procedural steps, Then the system validates and stores the protocol-specific attributes.
Given an existing material creation endpoint, When a user submits raw data with sample metrics, Then the system validates and stores the data-specific structures.
Given the patched models, When QA unit and integration tests are run, Then they pass successfully verifying all material types.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce distinct entity model fragmentation from >2 workarounds to 0

epics.title: Material and Protocol Revision History
epics.jtbd: When an epidemiological protocol or material description is updated, I want the system to track previous versions and maintain a revision history, so that I can audit changes and revert to older versions.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase revision tracking coverage from 0% to 100% of material updates
requirements: R1: Track and maintain a history of previous versions when materials or protocols are updated.
R2: Provide access to a detailed list of historical revisions including author, time, and content.

slices.title: Implement revision history tracking for materials
slices.jtbd: When implementing versioning for this epic, I want to patch the existing entities and endpoints to record and expose historical versions, so that auditing requirements are met.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material or protocol, When it is edited and saved, Then the previous version is stored in the revision history.
Given a material with history, When a user requests its revisions, Then a list showing who changed what and when is returned.
Given the implemented history tracking, When QA unit and E2E tests are run, Then they verify the successful retrieval of past versions.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce untracked material changes from 100% to 0%

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase successful local deployments from <50% to 100%
requirements: R1: Diagnose and fix the root cause of the latest runtime or health check failure.
R2: Ensure the product successfully launches and passes its health check locally.

slices.title: Fix runtime health check failure
slices.jtbd: When implementing the runtime fix for this epic, I want to patch the startup sequence or environment configuration, so that the system successfully passes health checks on launch.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the current broken runtime state, When the fix is applied, Then the system launches without failure.
Given a launched system, When the health check is queried, Then it returns a healthy status.
Given the fixed system, When E2E startup tests are run, Then they pass successfully.
